summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Wrote bare-metal embedded C software for STM32 microcontrollers (timer-triggered ADC, interrupt-driven I2C driver, 3.68 KB Flash) and troubleshot 11 hardware/software integration failures to reach 100% pick reliability on a multi-controller robotic system. Works daily in C, Python and Git.

Linux Administration: systemd service management (unit files, auto-restart, non-root isolation)

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; troubleshot and resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used Git (GitLab) for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 embedded C firmware with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display, achieving 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1).

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through system-level troubleshooting and testing; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection from dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over a TCA9548A I2C mux (gripper-triggered close at 25 mm).

Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file-based config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control on STM32 with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override, receiving YOLOv8 tracking commands from an NVIDIA Jetson over UART.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles (4-bit A/B transition state machine on hardware interrupts) and drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM on Arduino Due via DuePWM.
Built closed-loop heading correction from dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR) fed back into rotation PWM; added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect.
